name: Full Randomizer
description: Seed 1, everything on. Every enemy species that appears in a squad is appended as a real creature carrying the donor's model, moves and innate abilities at the local power level; groups move between spawn points within their difficulty band; gear and Chao effects are re-rolled with matching descriptions; chests, shop stock, drop tables and quest rewards are redealt. Bosses, story spawns, key items and quest tokens are never touched.
